initial_access_failure: Sandbox GitHub HTTPS proxy 127.0.0.1 unreachable; not interpreted as missing remote files
successful_access: Read-only git ls-remote outside sandbox returned main and the fixed commit
remote_evidence_method: Advertised remote commit equals existing local immutable commit; commit and relevant tree IDs recomputed. Read its tree/blob IDs using cat-file/ls-tree without fetch, replacement objects or Git writes.
note_zh: LF等价仅解释字节差异，不把不同字节写成一致；不改变输入哈希或原文件。
note_en: LF equivalence explains byte differences only; differing bytes are not called identical. No input hashes or original files are changed.
